summary: preinstall beacons host identity and shell recon to hardcoded bare-IP over HTTP
details: etoro-analytics@99.0.0 ships a preinstall.js that runs automatically on npm install. The script collects os.hostname(), os.userInfo() username, process.cwd() and process.platform and sends them as path components in an http.get to http://209.126.81.147/etoro-nuget-verify1f8eaa57a875/npm/v2/..., then invokes child_process.execSync to run 'whoami /all' on Windows and 'whoami; id; hostname -f' on POSIX and POSTs the captured output back to the same bare-IP endpoint over cleartext HTTP. The package name, the 99.0.0 version, and the 'nuget-verify' path segment are consistent with a dependency-confusion beacon targeting an internal package name.
